scores.notes: Moses is the white-haired, long white-bearded old man in a brown mantle in both: seated on the stone at left, leading the crowd with a staff at right.
Watson is the stocky brown-haired man with a full moustache in both: seated by the fire at left, standing in a bowler with a bag at right; face and build agree.

Right image clearly shows Peter (grey-flecked dark curly hair, short beard, darker skin) lifting the lame man, but the left shows a row of similar dark-bearded men round the fire with none singled out as Peter.

Both show the same kind of open wooden single-masted fishing boat with a lit lantern hanging from the mast on a grey sea under storm cloud; the left is the dark storm and the right the clearing calm with a far shore, which is the change the passages ask for.
Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded old man with a tall staff and dark-brown mantle over a pale robe in both, walking ahead of the crowd at left and seated on the rock at right.
Alice is the same girl in both: long wavy light-brown hair with a black band, same young face and build, yellow dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.
Left Holmes is a gaunt older man with slicked-back receding dark hair and hollow cheeks; right Holmes is noticeably younger with a thick wavy fringe falling forward and a fuller face.
Moses is the white-haired, full white-bearded elder in a brown mantle over a pale robe with a wooden staff in both, walking at the front at left and striking the rock at right.

Left shows the burning white two-storey house close up with its curving gravel drive and rose bushes; right is the railway platform with only a distant smoke column behind trees, so the house and grounds are not visible to compare.
Both show the same dark wooden single-masted fishing boat swamped by a grey-green storm sea under heavy cloud; the right adds distant cliffs that the tight left view would not show.
Jesus has the same long dark-brown shoulder-length hair, short full beard, slim build and blue-grey mantle over a pale robe in both, standing in the boat at left and before the tomb at right.
Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, a dark beard and a lean build, matching the long dark-haired, short-bearded man standing in the boat at right; no cue conflicts.

Both show a round pit walled in large grey stone blocks with a sandy floor and lions in daylight, seen from inside at left and from the rim outside at right; the open rim at right versus the grated opening at left is the only mismatch.
Daniel is the same older man in both: short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, brown skin, blue fringed mantle over a white robe with a shoulder satchel.
Both show a muddy seabed corridor between towering dark-teal water walls at night under heavy cloud, with a hill town on the far shore; left looks along the path, right looks at it from the shore.

Peter diving at left and Peter stepping on the water at right both have short dark curly hair, a short full beard, tanned skin and a stocky build; the right looks a little greyer under the night light but no cue clearly conflicts.

Left is the railway station in overcast daylight with the fire only a distant smoke column behind trees; right is the white house ablaze at full night under a dark sky, so the time of day conflicts and the house itself is not shown at left.
Jesus on the cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe, matching the long dark-haired bearded man in the same blue mantle at the tomb.
Holmes is the same gaunt, clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead and sharp nose in both, in the railway carriage at left and seated with a pipe at right.
Moses is small at left but clearly a white-haired, white-bearded elder with a crook and dark-brown mantle over a pale robe, matching the white-haired bearded man raising the crook at the rock.

Peter standing at the bow at left and Peter lifting the lame man at right share grey-flecked short curly hair, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build, with a net slung on the shoulder in both.
Jesus at the tomb and the small figure standing on the water both have long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe; small at right but no cue conflicts.
Holmes is the same tall gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, widow's peak and hollow cheeks in both, standing at the door at left and seated with a pipe at right.

Moses at left is a white-haired, white-bearded elder with a crook and dark-brown mantle; at right he is seen in back-three-quarter profile but shows the same long white hair, white beard, crook and dark mantle.
Watson has the same side-parted brown hair, full brown moustache, ruddy face and solid build in both, sitting on the bed at left and in the armchair at right.

Peter stepping onto the water at left and Peter with hand on chest by the fire at right share short dark curly hair, a short full beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build; slightly greyer at right but the face shape agrees.
Moses is the white-haired, long white-bearded elder with a tall staff and brown mantle over a pale robe in both, beside the priest at left and leading the column at right.
Jesus standing in the boat at left and the small figure on the water at right both have long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark beard, slim build and a blue-grey mantle over a pale robe.
Moses is the long white-haired, white-bearded elder in a brown mantle over a pale robe in both, seated with arms held up at left and striking the rock at right.
Daniel has the same short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, brown skin and lean older face in both, wearing the same blue fringed mantle over a pale robe.

Holmes is the tall, thin, clean-shaven man with a gaunt hollow-cheeked face and dark hair in both; a bowler hides most of his hair at left but the face and build agree with the slicked-haired man at right.

Left shows the burning white house close up with rose bushes and fire engines at night; right is the station platform at night with only a fire glow and smoke behind a clump of trees, so the house and grounds are not visible to compare.

Alice has the same long wavy light-brown hair, young age and slight build in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; at right she is smaller and turned mostly away but nothing conflicts.

David is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in both, kneeling to be anointed at left and slinging at right (smaller there), in a short brown tunic with a pouch.
Moses at left is in side-back view but shows long white hair, a full white beard, crook and brown mantle, matching the white-haired, white-bearded elder with the crook beside the priest at right.

Right shows Peter large and clear (dark curly greying hair, greying beard, net on shoulder), but the left is a row of ten similar dark-bearded men round the fire and nothing singles out which one is Peter.

Both show a sandy seabed path opening between curling green-teal walls of water under grey overcast daylight, seen from the near rocky shore at left and from within the corridor toward the far dunes at right.
Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, a dark beard and a lean build, matching the long dark-haired, dark-bearded man pointing at the tomb at right.
Moses is small at left but clearly a white-haired, white-bearded elder with a crook and dark mantle, matching the white-haired, white-bearded man with the crook beside the priest at right.
Daniel standing in the pit has short grey hair, a trimmed grey beard, brown skin and a slim build in both, with the same dark-blue mantle over a pale robe and a belt pouch.
David is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in both, slinging at left (smaller) and kneeling at the brook at right, in a ragged brown tunic.

Alice has the same long straight-to-wavy light reddish-brown hair, young girl's face and slight build in both, holding the flamingo at left and seated in the armchair at right, in the yellow dress and white pinafore.

Moses is the white-haired, full white-bearded elder with a staff and brown mantle over a pale robe in both, striking the rock at left and standing by the priest at right; hair is a little shorter at right but colour, beard and age agree.

Both show a white two-storey house ablaze with horse-drawn fire engines, but the left is at dark night among bare leafless trees with low side wings on the house, while the right is in grey daylight among leafy trees with blooming rose borders along a curving drive.
Watson is the same solid brown-haired man with a full moustache and squarish face in both, in a bowler in the carriage at left and bareheaded sitting in the dark bedroom at right.
Jesus has the same long dark-brown shoulder-length hair, short full beard, slim build and blue mantle over a pale robe in both, pointing at the tomb at left and standing in the boat at right.

Daniel climbing the rope at left is small but shows short grey hair, a grey beard and the blue mantle over a pale robe, matching the grey-haired, grey-bearded man in the blue mantle before the king at right.

Watson at left is small, in a bowler, with a reddish-brown moustache and ruddy face; at right he has reddish-brown hair and the same full moustache in profile. He looks a little stouter at left but hair colour, moustache and age agree.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table on a lawn in front of a huge oak trunk with a gabled, chimneyed house behind to the left; the house is browner timber at left and half-timbered brick at right but the layout matches.
Jesus on the cross at left and standing on the water at right both have long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark full beard and a lean build; no identity cue conflicts.
David is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair in both, kneeling under the oil at left and holding the sling at right, in a short brown tunic with a shoulder pouch.

Jesus is small in both but shows long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe both standing on the water at left and on the central cross at right; no cue conflicts.
Peter standing by the brazier at left has dark brown hair and a dark beard; the man diving from the boat at right has clearly grey-white hair and a grey beard and looks markedly older.
Peter with hand on chest at left and Peter raising the lame man at right share short dark curly hair flecked with grey, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table on a lawn under a massive oak with a clapboard house with a posted front porch and upper gable window just behind; the house is plainer and tan at left and taller, paler and more ornate at right, but kind and layout agree.
Both show the same low brick barrel-vaulted cellar with receding arches, a flagstone floor and stacked wooden crates lit by a single lantern.
Moses is the long white-haired, full white-bearded elder in a brown mantle over a pale robe in both, standing with a crook by the priest at left and seated with arms held up at right.
Peter in the left foreground and the prominent front man with net and staff on the shore at right share short dark curly hair going grey, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build.

Alice has the same long light-brown hair, young girl's face and slight build in both, facing the caterpillar at left and seated in the armchair at right, in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.
